title: Security researchers sign open letter against US ban on Claude Fable 5
summary: 300+ cybersecurity leaders signed an open letter demanding the export ban be reversed, after researcher Katie Moussouris said the trigger was a simple 'fix this code' prompt rather than a true jailbreak; Amodei met administration officials without resolution.
reason: Government holding a frontier model offline shows state leverage over labs (power concentration in the state); contested by experts.

title: Anthropic opens Seoul office, signs AI-safety MOU with Korea's science ministry
summary: Anthropic's Seoul office opened with Naver, Samsung SDS and LG CNS deals; an MOU with Korea's Ministry of Science and ICT covers Korean-language safety evaluations with the Korea AI Safety Institute and cyber-threat sharing.

title: G7 Evian summit hosts AI lab CEOs; agrees minors' online protections
summary: G7 leaders held an AI session with Altman, Amodei and Hassabis and agreed principles to protect minors from harmful AI content, but weakened data-center sustainability goals over US objections.
reason: Soft multilateral statement; diluted by US resistance.
